revision_note: The revision the oracle route digest is re-derivable FROM. An earlier stamp said 8cb4c5f79cf6, which predates every line of this mission: it was captured by 67d60532bb0d45503d1e2e2864c3ba81664e26bb while the tree was uncommitted, so no revision could have reproduced it. route_inputs_not_in_git.why: oracle_route_digest digests three things and git holds one. The route digest exists BECAUSE a source-only digest is insufficient, so the property that makes it a good pin is the property that makes it unrecoverable from a commit.
